notes: WhaleChat 3.78.0 — email is delivered through the Brevo SMTP relay for verification codes, transactional mail and receipts; SMS notifications and OTP use Telesign (with Brevo SMS as fallback). Admin panel pages no longer auto-repaint while an admin is reading or editing: timer/sync-driven renders are suppressed on admin routes and every nested scroll panel, focused field and caret position is preserved across the repaints that do happen.
